sort: stable descending sequence_score, ties retain generation_order
hit: any target SID match within K; equals Recall for single target
ndcg: sum all target SID matches at ranks r<=K of 1/log2(r+1)
mrr: 1/r for FIRST target SID occurrence r<=K, otherwise 0
cce: first target only; P=sum(prefix group sizes); g=target group size; m=min(g,max(0,K-P)); ItemHit=m/g; ItemNDCG=sum(i=1..m,1/log2(P+i+1))/g
cce_duplicates: each prefix occurrence expands; target first occurrence only
duplicate_rate: (K-number of distinct SIDs in user Top-K)/(users*K), including invalid SIDs
collision_candidate: valid SID whose catalog group size >1

popularity.source: every original training-visible items[:-2] occurrence once per user
popularity.thresholds: positive catalog frequencies, nearest-rank ceil(n/3),ceil(2*n/3), ties never split
popularity.groups: UNSEEN count=0; LONG_TAIL 0<count<=q1; MID q1<count<=q2; POPULAR count>q2
popularity.designation: SUPPLEMENTARY_ANALYSIS; exploratory grouping fixed before performance calculation

bootstrap.scope: Overall16 conditional on fixed trained model and fixed shuffle realization, not training-seed or shuffle-realization variance

per_user_format: CSV in row_idx order, no candidate texts; identity, groups, first rank, generation_seconds and 16 float64 metric columns; companion NPZ float64 matrix
cost_format: wall seconds per stage separately from GPU-device-seconds; per-user generation_seconds excludes model loading and CPU serialization
